title: 1400. Construct K Palindrome Strings

examples.explanation: You can construct two palindromes using all characters in s. Some possible constructions "anna" + "elble", "anbna" + "elle", "anellena" + "b"
It is impossible to construct 3 palindromes using all the characters of s.
The only possible solution is to put each character in a separate string.
